# FlareThemeScope

`Flare.Components.FlareThemeScope`

Re-themes one subtree without disturbing the rest of the app - a dark toolbar over a light page, or a preview pane showing another design system. Each axis left unset keeps the surrounding theme's answer, so a scope can change only the mode, only the palette, or all three.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Child content rendered under the scoped theme. |
| `Class` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Extra CSS classes for the wrapper element. |
| `Mode` | `ThemeMode?` | `` | Parameter |  | Light/dark mode for the subtree. Unset inherits the outer mode. |
| `Palette` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Color palette id to apply to the subtree. Unset inherits the outer palette. |
| `Style` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Inline style for the wrapper element. |
| `Theme` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Design-system theme id to apply to the subtree. Unset inherits the outer theme. |
